scope: Frontier DOM component behavior with an explicit simulation test double. Does not verify real economy, combat, navigation, or earned play.

checks.name: Disabled construction shows its price and an actionable reason
Wall lines preview total cost and preserve invalid placement mode
Named recruitment survives live DOM updates without detached controls
Company targets only player troops and shows training/healing limitations
A settlement world hit opens diplomacy even when it also has a fortification hit
War requires a visible consequence confirmation before issuing the action
Actual island chart focuses land and closes the panel with keyboard Find alternatives retained
Phone frontier panels and touch actions fit a 390px viewport
